g.text: I've never been called an "asshat" before.
I've got more where that came from.
I'm sure I'll hear all your clever insults eventually.
I thought I'd experienced most of the world, until I met you.
That whole "I have feelings for you" thing? It was a joke.
I-- wait. Sorry. No. I meant it. Go on.
I have a sick sense of humor.
When I joined the ICR - even before then, I was a military man.
I've lived my entire life with one foot in the grave. I've always been as good as dead.
And it's never been more true than now. Look at me. I mean *look at me.*
So...we've had a chance to get to know each other. We've grown a bit close, yeah? You...make me laugh.
You make me smile more than I have in years.
But how can you want to be with someone...like me?
Arthur, you mean more to me than you can imagine.
I have a thing for toaster ovens?
I don't care "what's happened to you."
And you've instantly made me regret this.
Let me know if you change your mind.
You're *you.* And that's what I'm here for. And that's who I want to be with.
Of everything that's happened in this cursed year, I never dreamed...never even imagined...
You really want to try this? Us?
Maybe not yet? Can we take more time? [End.]
